text_block_list.text:
After failing to seize first place in the
Japanese
Derby, Кинг Хало bites her lip
in frustration. She
tries to put on a brave
front despite the loss.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her mother calls to praise Special
Week's
performance and urge Кинг Хало
to give up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before hanging up, her mother coldly
advises her
to come home before she
disgraces herself even
further. I watch
tears well up in Кинг Хало's eyes
as she
makes another vow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She promises to win the final round of
the Classic
Triple Crown tour and
declares that her skill
deserves to be
recognized.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
